theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_mv_ball_of_kernel
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ContinuousOn h (closedBall x r) → (∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∫ y : Euclid n, h (x - y) * g (‖y‖ ^ 2) = h x * ∫ y : Euclid n, g (‖y‖ ^ 2)) → ∫ y in ball x r, h y = (volume (ball x r)).toReal * h x
